experiments/star-field/engine/types.ts

Shared types for the star-field engine — the static body
Sourcesrc/experiments/star-field/engine/types.ts
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

(module scope)

The TSL node-graph namespace (compiled to WGSL/GLSL by the renderer).

(module scope)

The lazily-imported three module namespace.

(module scope)

Lazily-loaded node-material context — the renderer is WebGPURenderer (WebGPU or forced-WebGL backend), whose node pipeline rejects classic GLSL ShaderMaterials. Every custom-shaded surface (fresnel limbs, boundary shells, the accretion disc) is therefore built as a node material: bootstrap injects the TSL namespace and the node material ctor so the body builders stay pure/mockable.

TSL

The three/tsl module namespace.

mats

Node-material constructors re-exported by three/webgpu.

(module scope)

Static catalog entry — everything the scene needs to place a body, declared once per body in catalog.ts. Orbiting bodies set orbit + parent; fixed deep-sky objects set pos directly.

id

Body id — matches public/data/<id>.json and data-body attrs.

name

Display fallback before the dossier JSON loads.

kind

SF_KINDS value — drives badge label + material recipe.

group

SF_GROUPS value — navigator drawer bucket.

radius

Visual radius in scene units (compressed chart, not to scale).

(module scope)

Orbit radius around parent — omit for fixed positions.

(module scope)

Id of the body it orbits (default: scene origin).

(module scope)

Orbit angular speed multiplier (0 for fixed bodies).

(module scope)

Self-rotation speed multiplier.

(module scope)

Starting angle on the orbit (radians).

(module scope)

Orbital inclination about the parent's x-axis (radians) — tilts the whole orbit plane, not the body. Real multi-planet systems share near-coplanar planes but are never perfectly aligned; small nonzero values break the edge-on straight-line illusion while still reading as a resonant chain. Written to pivot.rotation.x at build so it survives the per-frame rotation.y orbit sweep.

(module scope)

Orbital eccentricity 0–1 — when set, the pivot still sweeps the angle uniformly but the mesh's radial distance follows the conic r = a(1−e²)/(1+e·cos θ) so the body draws a visible ellipse (Halley-type comets) instead of the default circle. orbit reads as the semi-major axis and phase as the periapsis longitude.

(module scope)

Axial tilt (radians).

(module scope)

SF_TEXTURES key material map — omit for procedural bodies.

(module scope)

SF_COLORS hex for procedural material/emissive tint.

(module scope)

Limb tint override (SF_COLORS hex) — the fresnel mixes toward this at the silhouette instead of the default hot STAR_RIM. A darker rim produces limb darkening on resolved star discs (the Sun): we see deeper hotter layers at centre, cooler gas at the limb.

(module scope)

Corona activity scale (1 = quiet star) — stretches prominences, adds eruption plumes and sunspots, and enlarges the corona sprite. The Sun runs above 1 so its surface reads as an active photosphere.

(module scope)

Secondary texture for translucent shells (Venus atmosphere, Saturn ring).

(module scope)

Shell is a flat ring disc rather than an atmosphere sphere — with no shellTexture a seeded procedural band strip is painted instead (Uranus/Neptune's thin dusty arcs), so any body can carry rings.

(module scope)

Ring radii as body-radius multiples — default to Saturn's strip (SF_DETAIL.RING_INNER/OUTER); ice giants override with their honest narrower spans (Uranus's rings hug 1.6–2.0 R, not Saturn's wide plate).

(module scope)

Procedural band count override for ringStripFor — default SF_DETAIL.RING_BANDS; real systems differ wildly (Jupiter 4 faint rings, Uranus 13 razor-thin arcs, Neptune 5 dusty arcs) so the catalog pins the honest count per body.

(module scope)

Bump/relief map (Earth terrain shading) — lit-materials only.

(module scope)

Grayscale elevation map — bumpMap gives terrain real depth relief.

(module scope)

Night-lights emissive map — glows only where the map is lit.

(module scope)

Atmosphere rim shell (0 = off) — a fresnel-limb translucent sphere just past the surface whose tint migrates day→dusk→night with the sun direction (Earth); the value scales the shell's opacity.

(module scope)

Cloud deck texture — extra translucent sphere one layer up.

(module scope)

Fixed scene position [x,y,z] for non-orbiting deep-sky objects.

(module scope)

Procedural spiral galaxy — render the seeded Points disc instead of a flat sprite. count is the star-particle target (capped by SF_SPIRAL.COUNT_MAX, divided on mobile) standing in for the galaxy's true stellar population; arms overrides the arm count. volumetric drops the photographic quad entirely (the Milky Way is viewed from inside — a face-on photo is geometrically false) and thickens the particle disc; elliptical fills a smooth spheroid for dwarf-spheroidal members that have no spiral structure.

(module scope)

Disc-thickness multiplier on SF_SPIRAL.THIN.

(module scope)

Arm angular jitter (rad) — overrides SF_SPIRAL.ARM_JITTER.

(module scope)

Spherical stellar-halo fraction (0–1) layered over the disc.

(module scope)

Heliocentric exclusion bubble radius (chart units) — particles are resampled away from the Sun's position inside the disc so random disc stars never overlap the solar-system meshes (Milky Way only).

(module scope)

Relativistic-jet cones on a black-hole body — bipolar additive cylinders along the disc normal sized by SF_BH.

(module scope)

Cosmic-hierarchy boundary — a faint translucent shell sphere of radius chart units plus an interior speckle cloud standing in for member galaxies. Structures are not raycast-pickable (their shell would swallow every pointer ray); the navigator still flies to them.

(module scope)

Small-body annulus (asteroid/Kuiper belt) — inner/outer are the ring bounds in chart units, count the particle budget, puff the vertical half-thickness multiplier on def.radius. The def's radius doubles as the camera-framing value on fly-to; the def's color tints the particles. gapFreq overrides the Kirkwood-lane modulation frequency (0 = smooth disc, no resonance gaps).

(module scope)

Luminosity pulse — slow breathing scale oscillation for variable stars, pulsars and flaring cores; period in seconds, amp the ± scale fraction (0.1 = ±10%).

(module scope)

Climate cycle — oscillates the surface material tint toward SF_COLORS.EARTH_ICE (glaciation winter→summer analogy); period in seconds.

(module scope)

Procedural weather — replaces the static cloudTexture deck with the full weather.ts field: evolving coverage, jet streams, ITCZ monsoon band, hurricane vortices, seasonal snow lines, volcanic ash plumes and matching surface cloud shadows (Earth).

(module scope)

Aurora shell — a thin rayed emission OVAL centered on the magnetic pole (not the spin pole), driven by the shared solar-wind uniform so solar storms light every aurora-bearing body at once (Earth, Jupiter, Saturn, Neptune). Pass true for the default Earth-green oxygen palette, or a config object for per-body physics: color/colorLow are the curtain-top/lower-edge emissions, tilt the magnetic dipole's offset from the spin axis (radians — Neptune's is ~0.82 rad ≈ 47°), lat the oval's |lat| center and intensity a brightness multiplier (Jupiter > Earth > Saturn > Neptune, matching real emitted power).

(module scope)

False → boreal oval only (Earth); default shows both poles.

(module scope)

Solar flares — limb prominence sprites on the photosphere edge that breathe and stretch outward with the shared solar-wind cycle (Sun).

(module scope)

LEO constellation shell — count point glints sharing one inclined orbital plane at orbit× radius, sweeping as a unit (the Starlink swarm; orbit multiplies def.radius). An id/name pair turns the whole shell into a dossier-backed pick target like a catalogued companion: an invisible pick bubble at the shell radius registers the swarm in pickables/nodes/anchors so clicking the glint annulus (but not the planet it wraps — the proxy loses to any real mesh hit along the ray) opens the near-orbit dossier.

(module scope)

Meteor strikes — airless cratered bodies still take impacts; a pooled flash sprite fires at a random surface point every SF_METEOR.INTERVAL-ish seconds (updateFx). For bodies whose dossier describes ongoing bombardment — the flash makes the crater record readable as a live process.

(module scope)

Irregular rubble-pile body — replaces the perfect SphereGeometry with a seeded noise-crumpled icosahedron: each vertex displaces along its own normal by vnoise(unit+offset)·amp·radius and the whole solid stretches along axes (triaxial proportions, default seeded mild). For moons whose dossier JSON describes a lumpy captured asteroid (Phobos, Deimos) rather than a hydrostatic ball — the silhouette carries the physics (tidal stripping, rubble re-accretion) the sphere could never show.

amp

Crumple depth as a fraction of the body radius (0–1).

(module scope)

Triaxial proportions [x, y, z] — the body's three radii normalized to x=1 (Phobos ≈ [1, 0.81, 0.67]).

(module scope)

Procedural-surface recipe pin — one of SF_SURFACES (rock, ice, gas, lava, ocean). The painter's kind bias still seeds the grain, but the recipe forces the read: a molten Proxima d can never draw water bands, an oceanic TRAPPIST-1e always carries seas. Absent → seeded pick inside the kind's palette as before.

dist

Authored distance label for the hover tooltip — semi-major axis in AU for Solar-System bodies, light-years for deep-sky objects. Units are universal abbreviations so the string needs no translation.

(module scope)

Companion bodies orbiting this body's mesh — the representation for a galactic star's planetary system (TRAPPIST-1 b–h, Epsilon Eridani b) and for crafted orbiters (the ISS). Entries render inside the host's LOD detail set so a system's planets only resolve once the camera is inside the approach distance; ecc/phase carry the real conic. An entry carrying id/name registers as a pickable dossier body like any catalog world.

(module scope)

Dossier-backed pick id — when set, the companion registers as a real node (anchor + pick proxy) so a close-up click resolves to a lazy public/data/<locale>/<id>.json dossier like any catalog body. Anonymous companions stay decorative and unpickable.

(module scope)

Display name for the dossier-backed companion.

(module scope)

Crafted-station flag — renders the companion as a lit truss + solar-panel model (the ISS silhouette) instead of the default fresnel glow ball, so crewed orbiters read as built objects, not second moons.

(module scope)

Same conic rule as SFBodyDef.ecc — radial distance modulates around the circular pivot sweep.

(module scope)

Atmosphere tint override (SF_COLORS hex) — the rim shell normally migrates Earth's day/dusk/night palette; bodies with a chemically different sky (Titan's tholin haze) pin the limb to their own hue.

(module scope)

Cryovolcanic/volcanic plume system — animated geyser/volcano vents that throw ejecta sprites into space (Enceladus' south-polar tiger stripes, Io's scattered sulfur plumes). polar clusters the vents around the south pole; color tints the jets (water-ice vs sulfur), height overrides the reach as a body-radius multiple.

(module scope)

Vent count — defaults to SF_PLUME.VENTS.

(module scope)

True → vents cluster at the south pole (Enceladus tiger stripes).

(module scope)

Plume tint (SF_COLORS hex) — ejecta particle color.

(module scope)

Jet reach × body radius — defaults to SF_PLUME.HEIGHT.

(module scope)

One media asset inside a dossier — the file lives under public/media/<id>/ and renders with caption + credit (NASA/ESA/… attribution is required by the sources' usage terms).

src

Asset path relative to SF_DATA_BASE-adjacent media root.

(module scope)

Localized caption/alt text.

(module scope)

Credit line (e.g. "NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS").

(module scope)

Poster frame for videos (relative path).

(module scope)

Provenance signature — when the dossier's source data was acquired and when this locale's translation was produced (ISO dates), plus the reference URLs the facts were paraphrased from.

acquired

ISO date the source data/media was downloaded.

translated

ISO date this locale's text was translated/written.

locale

The locale this file serves (en for the canonical file).

(module scope)

Reference URLs the dossier paraphrases (NASA/JPL/Trek/SVS/ESO).

(module scope)

A named prose section — dossiers with sections render the deep history as titled subsections (formation, exploration, geology, …) instead of one flat paragraph.

(module scope)

Lazy-loaded dossier JSON shape — public/data/<locale>/<id>.json. Facts render as a definition list; history/sections are prose; source credits the data provenance (NASA, ESO, …); media is a curated gallery; meta carries the acquisition/translation signature.

(module scope)

Optional prose subsections for deep-history bodies.

(module scope)

Downloaded gallery — images, videos, audio recordings.

(module scope)

Acquisition/translation signature.

(module scope)

Raw public/data/<locale>/<id>.json file shape — each locale folder ships one self-contained dossier per body so only the active language downloads; id, kind and source are locale-neutral.

(module scope)

Locale-neutral proper-named star table shipped inside en/milky-way.json — real HYG catalogue entries (heliocentric light-years) kept for future labels and the browse index.

(module scope)

Progress callback — loader overlay message + 0–100 percent.

(module scope)

Body-approach/select notification — the host fetches the dossier JSON.

(module scope)

Mutable engine state — one bag threaded through bootstrap/frame/fly so every stage shares renderer, scene graph, tweens and dispose flags without a class field soup.

canvas

Persistent canvas the host owns (replaced on renderer retry).

renderer

three.js WebGPURenderer (WebGPU or forced-WebGL backend).

pipeline

RenderPipeline post chain (scene → +bloom → vignette → film grain) — null when the pipeline failed to build or the backend rejected it; the frame loop falls back to renderer.render(scene, camera) in that case, losing post FX but never the scene.

world

Floating-origin world root — every catalog body, cloud and rider parents under this group instead of the scene directly. The follow step counter-translates it so the followed anchor sits at the world origin: rider-mounted bodies translate up to ~16k units/s on the galactic ring, which would otherwise push all coordinates to ~6.7M where float32 quantization (±0.5 units) visibly jitters every mesh. Skybox and lights stay on the scene at the origin — the pin point — so they always enclose/light whatever the camera follows.

sunLight

Sun stand-in point light — created in the scene at the origin (the pin point), then re-parented onto the Sun anchor once bodies build so it keeps illuminating from the Sun's real position whichever body the floating origin currently pins.

nodes

id → runtime body node record.

anchors

id → center Object3D the camera targets (equals mesh for most).

pickables

Pickable meshes for raycasting.

dayNight

Day/night shader registry — bodies with sun-direction-dependent shading (night-lights emissive gating, atmosphere rim shells). Each frame updateDayNight writes dir = normalize(sunPos − bodyPos) into the shared vector the material's TSL uniform wraps, so lights stay dark on the lit hemisphere and the rim migrates with the terminator.

(module scope)

Light-source anchor override — galactic planets (TRAPPIST-1's worlds, Proxima's) are lit by their host star, not the solar Sun, so their day/night vector resolves against the parent's anchor instead of the default sunLight. Moons of planets (Io, Enceladus) keep the default: they orbit a planet but are still lit by the real Sun.

approached

ids whose dossier was already prefetched — approach fires once.

solarWind

Shared solar-wind uniform — updateSolarWind writes the 0–1+ activity level each frame; aurora shells, the sun's flare sprites and the corona breathe with it so a storm visibly propagates from the Sun to every atmosphere-bearing planet. TSL uniform node (runtime .value), null until bootstrap creates it.

fxTime

Shared scene-time uniform (scene seconds) — the weather field, aurora curtains and any other TSL effect reads this instead of baking s.t so a single per-frame write animates every shader.

starCloud

Real-star cloud Points (HYG catalogue field on the Milky Way disc) — set by star-cloud.ts once the packed binary decodes; kept on state so destroy() can dispose its geometry/material.

starCloudLoading

Guard flag — the star-cloud fetch fires only once per boot.

THREE

Post-boot handles kept for lazy registry-body spawns — the deep catalog's 139k records are plain cloud points until selected, when registry-body.ts builds a real textured mesh on demand. Bootstrap stashes the three module, node-material deps and the shared glow sprite here so spawn code never re-imports lazily-loaded modules.

glowTex

Shared soft-disc sprite — registry halos reuse it, never own it.

registryBodies

Spawned registry bodies (star-NNNNNN… → Object3D) mounted on the Sun's pivot — an LRU map capped at SF_STAR_CLOUD.BODY_CACHE so a long browsing session never accumulates 139k meshes.

fly

Active fly-to tween or null when controls are free.

animId

Active RAF id.

disposed

Set by destroy() — every async stage checks before continuing.

failed

Bootstrap failed or bailed — host swaps in the CSS fallback.

reduced

Reduced-motion flag — pauses the RAF loop.

onResize

Resize listener to detach on destroy.

onPointerDown

Pointer listeners to detach on destroy.

downXY

last pointer-down position for click-vs-drag discrimination.

pickX

Pending hover-pick position — the freshest coalesced pointer sample. High-rate mice (1000Hz+) fire several pointermoves per frame; the handler only records scalars and the rAF tick raycasts once per frame against the latest pair, never once per event.

pickRaf

Non-null while a per-frame pick tick is queued — dedupes rAF arms.

viewW

Cached canvas box in CSS px — refreshed by handleStarResize. The per-frame projection (anchorScreenPos/worldScreenPos) and galaxy-cloud updates read these instead of clientWidth/ clientHeight so hover tracking and fades never issue a layout read inside the render loop. 0 = not measured yet (cold path falls back to a one-time live read).

lastT

Last tick timestamp for dt-based animation.

t

Elapsed scene time (seconds) — drives orbits/spins.

hoverId

Camera hover state — last picked body id for the HUD.

hint

Navigator-hover position hint — while the pointer (or focus) rests on a catalog row the engine reports the body's projected screen position every tick, edge-clamped so the hint works at any zoom level. Plain data, resolved per tick in trackHover: catalog ids carry their anchor (live world position) and registry rows carry their shard rec (resolved via registryWorldPos in the pinned frame). Null when no nav row is hovered; takes precedence over hoverId (the pointer is on the drawer, not the canvas).

selectedId

Selected body id (panel open).

followId

Camera-follow anchor — which catalog id the camera rides with when no fly tween runs. Selections set it to the picked body; the solar overview sets it to the Sun so the chart holds the solar system while it orbits inside the galactic disc — without marking a dossier selection. Null = free camera.

(module scope)

Lifecycle callbacks from the host.

(module scope)

Per-frame hover tracking — fires every tick while a body is hovered with its projected canvas-space pixel position, so the tooltip and its leader line follow orbiting bodies without DOM thrash. edge marks the projected point as clamped to the canvas edge (object off-screen or behind) and angle carries the outward direction in degrees for the leader-line arrow.

(module scope)

Fires once when a frame throws — host swaps to the 2D fallback.

(module scope)

Per-body runtime node — pivot (orbit rotation), mesh, and its def.

pivot

Object3D that orbits — rotates around the parent's center.

mesh

The pickable mesh/sprite — carries userData.bodyId.

spinner

Spin target (mesh or its inner group) for self-rotation.

(module scope)

Body-system center — the group that carries the orbit radius (position.x = def.orbit) and hosts everything that must share the body's location but NOT its orientation: the axis-lock group, the bare mesh, satellite pivots and constellation swarms. It never rotates itself, so children orbit the body's center in the pivot frame instead of inheriting surface spin or lock counter-rotation. For orbiting bodies this is also the eccentric-orbit target — frame.ts rewrites its position.x with the conic radius.

(module scope)

Inertial axis lock — a group between the orbit pivot and the mesh carrying rotation.z = tilt and counter-rotated on Y each frame. Without it the pivot's orbital Y-rotation precesses the spin axis with the body's position (perpetual solstice); the lock keeps the axis fixed in the parent frame so the terminator sweeps the hemispheres over the orbit — real seasons. Only set on directly orbiting tilted bodies.

(module scope)

Differential-rotation subgroup — a volumetric galaxy's inner-disc Points cloud; tickFrame spins it at ROTOR_DIFF× the whole-disc rate so the core laps the rim the way real rotation curves do.

(module scope)

Cloud-deck shell — Earth's cloud sphere rides inside mesh so it inherits surface spin; with def.weather the deck is the procedural field (jets/storms/snow evolve in the shader via the shared fxTime uniform), and updateFx still adds its legacy differential drift for static-texture decks.

(module scope)

Solar limb flares — prominence sprites from makeSolarFlares; updateFx scales/opacities them by solarWind × sin⁴(t·rate+phase) so eruptions breathe and spike outward when a storm hits.

(module scope)

Meteor flash pool — SF_METEOR.POOL sprites parented to the mesh, recycled across strikes so impact flashes never allocate per frame; meteorNext schedules the next strike (scene seconds).

t0

Strike start time (scene seconds) — drives the fade curve.

(module scope)

Next scheduled meteor strike time (scene seconds).

satPivots

Satellite pivots (decorative companions) — rotate per frame.

mesh

Satellite mesh riding the pivot — modulated when ecc is set.

orbit

Semi-major axis (chart units) + eccentricity for elliptical orbits.

(module scope)

Self-tumble rate — belt hero rocks spin their own mesh on top of the orbit sweep so debris reads as tumbling rubble, not rails.

(module scope)

LOD-toggleable secondary geometry — atmosphere shells, ring discs, satellite pivots; frame.ts hides these beyond the detail distance so far bodies draw as one primitive.

(module scope)

Volumetric-galaxy Points cache — updateGalaxyClouds resolves the userData.volumetric child once and parks the handle here so the per-frame fade never re-walks mesh.children (a .find call allocates its predicate closure every frame otherwise).

(module scope)

Star corona sprite — the seeded streamer texture from procedural.coronaFor; updateFx rotates material.rotation and breathes material.opacity so stars shimmer like live suns.

(module scope)

Interstellar-collapse glyph — a flat point-glow sprite riding the pivot beside the real mesh, plus its own pick proxy. updateLod shows them (and hides the sphere) once the camera passes SF_LOD.SOLAR_FAR so the whole solar tier reads as a single bright star like every other sun in the neighborhood. Solar stars only.

(module scope)

Invisible pick bubble kept live while farGlow shows.

(module scope)

Galactic-star far glyph — the flat point-glow sprite a point star wears at chart distances. updateLod hides it while the node's near-field group (real photosphere sphere + annulus halo + corona + flares, parked on detail) resolves on approach, so the star reads as an unresolvable point from range and as its spectral class up close.

(module scope)

Living-nebula animation record — parked on the sprite's userData by makeNebulaSprite (SF_USER_NEBULA) and lifted here so updateFx can churn the depth layers each frame.

(module scope)

Comet tail/coma animation record — updateFx reads the live conic radius off center.position.x (frame.ts writes it for ecc orbits) and re-drives each tail's particle field between rMin (periapsis — full stream) and rMax (apoapsis — near-invisible stub), reproducing how sublimation scales with solar flux. Each Points layer carries its seeded grain field in userData.gasPts — the record only needs the object handles.

ion

Ion-tail particle layers (core stream + diffuse sheath).

dust

Dust-tail particle layers (core stream + diffuse sheath).

coma

Coma glow sprite hugging the nucleus.

rMin

Periapsis/apoapsis distances (chart units) — the scale window.

comaScale

Resting coma scale captured at build, multiplied by the factor.

(module scope)

Cryovolcanic plume system — per-vent jet + cycling puff sprite records built by makePlumes; updateFx rises each puff along its vent direction, expands and fades it, and recycles it — continuous eruption with zero per-frame allocation.

jet

Steady tapered-cone jet rooted at the vent (shimmering column).

puff

Rising ejecta puff cycling outward along dir.

dir

Unit vent direction (body-local) — the ejecta axis.

phase

Seeded cycle phase (0–1) and rate multiplier.

radius

Body radius (spawn height) and jet reach (world units).

width

Puff base width (world units) — grows as it rises.

(module scope)

Shared body-local sun direction — the dayNight registry fills it each frame; updateFx dots it against dir so vents only jet when the sun lights their hemisphere (Elysium-dark vents go smudge).

(module scope)

Living-nebula fx record — the per-layer swirl state for a deep-sky sprite. Each entry owns one SpriteMaterial (primary photo, rotated echo ghost, or wide underlay glow); rate is rad/scene-second (the echo's is negative → counter-rotating shear), phase the seeded start angle, opBase the resting opacity the shimmer wave scales. baseScale captures the aspect-corrected sprite scale so the whole sprite can breathe without losing the photo's aspect.

phase

Seeded phase offset for the whole-sprite breathing wave.

(module scope)

Active camera fly-to tween — cubic ease-in-out over FLY_MS.

t0

Start time (performance.now snapshot).

fromPos

Camera position at tween start.

offset

Approach offset — destination sits this vector away from the body.

fromTgt

Controls target at tween start.

track

Live body-position getter — rider-mounted anchors keep moving while the tween runs, so the destination is re-resolved every frame; a static snapshot would land the camera where the body was at arm time. Returns null when the anchor is gone (dest frozen at last).

last

Last resolved body position — destination anchor when track yields null.

(module scope)

Optional follow-up when the tween completes (fire onSelect).
